info.title: CampusOS Backend
info.description:
CampusOS Backend API — Trusted Operating System for African Universities.
    Powered by Quai Network & Blip Pay.
    
    ### Flagship Module: Verified Student Identity (Milestone 2 & Milestone 3)
    - Multi-document upload to Cloudinary (Student ID, Admission Letter)
    - Institutional email (.edu.ng) validation
    - Administrative verification queue & review workflow
    - SHA-256 cryptographic credential hashing
    - Quai Network on-chain credential registration (`StudentIdentity` smart contract)
    - Permanent cryptographically signed Campus Identity QR
    - Strict OWASP security headers, rate limiting, and magic-bytes file validation
